title: Player enters a score via Score kiosk
description: The tournament organizer starts Score kiosk; both players stay present while entering sets and each PIN, then confirm the result.

steps.title: Active tournament
steps.body: Open the active event (Tutorial Active Round Robin). Before players can enter scores at the table, the tournament organizer must switch this terminal into Score kiosk mode.

steps.title: Organizer starts Score kiosk
steps.body: The tournament organizer taps Score kiosk once. That locks the terminal to this event so players can record results with PINs — without an organizer login at the table.

steps.title: Both players present
steps.body: Score kiosk is active. Both players in the match should be present at the table when entering the score — each will enter their own PIN to confirm.
steps.resultNote: Tournament score kiosk is active (Restore privileges visible).

steps.title: Open a match
steps.body: Tap an empty match cell for the two players who just finished.

steps.title: Enter first player’s sets
steps.body: Type the first player’s set count (here 3).

steps.title: First score entered
steps.body: The first player’s sets are filled in (3).

steps.title: Enter second player’s sets
steps.body: Type the second player’s set count (here 1).

steps.title: Second score entered
steps.body: Both set counts are in (3–1). Next each participant confirms with their score PIN.

steps.title: Enter first PIN
steps.body: The first participant types their score PIN (not their login password).

steps.title: First PIN entered
steps.body: The first participant’s PIN is filled. The second player enters theirs next.

steps.title: Enter second PIN
steps.body: The second participant types their score PIN to agree with the result.

steps.title: Second PIN entered
steps.body: Both PINs are in. Confirm to save the match.
steps.resultNote: Both participant PIN fields are filled.

steps.title: Confirm final score entry
steps.body: Tap the green checkmark to save. Both PINs must be correct for the result to record.
steps.actionHint: Click the green checkmark to save

steps.title: Score recorded
steps.body: The grid shows the saved result. The next empty match is ready for the next pair.
steps.resultNote: Match saved from Score kiosk with participant PINs.
